route: MCP sketch, cut, reference_plane, draft with pull and edit_draft -> real document rebuild -> pinned Catallax hollow oblique draft -> raw STEP check on one request allowance
supported_limits: Catallax's hollow oblique acceptance case: an 8/4 mm ring 2 mm tall, both walls drafted about the plane through (0, 0, 1) with normal (1, 0, 8), pulled along +z from the Z axis and then from the reversed start cap. The tilted neutral plane is a reference plane offset from a slanted cut face. The angle edits from 45 to -45 degrees; other angles on this part are refused with draft.unsupported-arrangement, and mass properties refuse the drafted body with measure.unsupported-surface, so the steps check its bounding box.
